sessionStart.prompt: Threski Studio plugin is available. Temporal contract: load_session_context ONCE for durable current team truth (working state, rules, fixes, decisions); ask_project for hybrid HEAD code + commit_chunk change meaning + current memory; why_changed for focused why/when forensics. Do not call memory_* on every turn. Use capture_observation sparingly for genuinely new reusable findings. Prefer Threski: Status / STATUS.md for setup — not settings_get / ticket_get_capabilities unless diagnosing missing AI keys or ticketing.

stop.prompt: Before finishing, assess whether this session produced a genuinely new, reusable lesson, correction, constraint, or surprising finding. If and only if it did, and it was not already captured, call capture_observation once with a concise standalone observation. Call load_session_context only when needed to avoid a duplicate or stale capture, and at most once per session. Otherwise finish without calling memory tools.
